entries.title: Ezekiel 21:1
segments: ¶And the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:2
segments: "Son of man, set your face toward Jerusalem, preach against the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel;

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:3
segments: "and say to the land of Israel, 'Thus says the LORD: "Behold, I [am] against you, and I will draw My sword out of its sheath and cut off both righteous and wicked from you.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:4
segments: "Because I will cut off both righteous and wicked from you, therefore My sword shall go out of its sheath against all flesh from south [to] north,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:5
segments: "that all flesh may know that I, the LORD, have drawn My sword out of its sheath; it shall not return anymore."'

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:6
segments: "Sigh therefore, son of man, with a breaking heart, and sigh with bitterness before their eyes.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:7
segments: "And it shall be when they say to you, 'Why are you sighing?' that you shall answer, 'Because of the news; when it comes, every heart will melt, all hands will be feeble, every spirit will faint, and all knees will be weak [as] water. Behold, it is coming and shall be brought to pass,' says the Lord GOD."

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:8
segments: ¶Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:9
segments: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'Thus says the LORD!' Say: 'A sword, a sword is sharpened And also polished!

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:10
segments: Sharpened to make a dreadful slaughter, Polished to flash like lightning! Should we then make mirth? It despises the scepter of My Son, [As it does] all wood.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:11
segments: And He has given it to be polished, That it may be handled; This sword is sharpened, and it is polished To be given into the hand of the slayer.'

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:12
segments: "Cry and wail, son of man; For it will be against My people, Against all the princes of Israel. Terrors including the sword will be against My people; Therefore strike [your] thigh.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:13
segments: "Because [it is] a testing, And what if [the sword] despises even the scepter? [The scepter] shall be no [more]," says the Lord GOD.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:14
segments: "You therefore, son of man, prophesy, And strike [your] hands together. The third time let the sword do double [damage]. It [is] the sword [that] slays, The sword that slays the great [men], That enters their private chambers.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:15
segments: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, That the heart may melt and many may stumble. Ah! [It is] made bright; [It is] grasped for slaughter:

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:16
segments: "Swords at the ready! Thrust right! Set your blade! Thrust left-Wherever your edge is ordered!

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:17
segments: "I also will beat My fists together, And I will cause My fury to rest; I, the LORD, have spoken."

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:18
segments: ¶The word of the LORD came to me again, saying:

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:19
segments: "And son of man, appoint for yourself two ways for the sword of the king of Babylon to go; both of them shall go from the same land. Make a sign; put [it] at the head of the road to the city.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:20
segments: "Appoint a road for the sword to go to Rabbah of the Ammonites, and to Judah, into fortified Jerusalem.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:21
segments: "For the king of Babylon stands at the parting of the road, at the fork of the two roads, to use divination: he shakes the arrows, he consults the images, he looks at the liver.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:22
segments: "In his right hand is the divination for Jerusalem: to set up battering rams, to call for a slaughter, to lift the voice with shouting, to set battering rams against the gates, to heap up a [siege] mound, and to build a wall.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:23
segments: "And it will be to them like a false divination in the eyes of those who have sworn oaths with them; but he will bring their iniquity to remembrance, that they may be taken.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:24
segments: "Therefore thus says the Lord GOD: 'Because you have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are uncovered, so that in all your doings your sins appear-because you have come to remembrance, you shall be taken in hand.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:25
segments: 'Now to you, O profane, wicked prince of Israel, whose day has come, whose iniquity [shall] end,

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:26
segments: 'thus says the Lord GOD: "Remove the turban, and take off the crown; Nothing [shall remain] the same. Exalt the humble, and humble the exalted.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:27
segments: Overthrown, overthrown, I will make it overthrown! It shall be no [longer], Until He comes whose right it is, And I will give it [to Him]."'

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:28
segments: ¶"And you, son of man, prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Lord GOD concerning the Ammonites and concerning their reproach,' and say: 'A sword, a sword [is] drawn, Polished for slaughter, For consuming, for flashing-

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:29
segments: While they see false visions for you, While they divine a lie to you, To bring you on the necks of the wicked, the slain Whose day has come, Whose iniquity [shall] end.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:30
segments: 'Return [it] to its sheath. I will judge you In the place where you were created, In the land of your nativity.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:31
segments: I will pour out My indignation on you; I will blow against you with the fire of My wrath, And deliver you into the hands of brutal men [who are] skillful to destroy.

entries.title: Ezekiel 21:32
segments: You shall be fuel for the fire; Your blood shall be in the midst of the land. You shall not be remembered, For I the LORD have spoken.'"
